products.overview: One drive, two jobs: dose to the microlitre, then switch over and empty the reactor fast. The Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 handles precise, repeatable dosing and rapid liquid transfer from the same drive, delivering 2.0 to 4,056 mL/min with +/-0.5% control accuracy across a 24 to 600 rpm speed range.
features: Retraction Function: Reverses the drive briefly after each run to clear the last drop at the tube tip and protect accuracy on small doses.
Interval Dosing: Dosing volume and pause time, from 0.1 seconds to 750 hours, are programmable for unattended filling sequences.
RS232 and Analogue Control: Speed, direction, and start/stop run over digital RS232 or analogue 0 to 10 V / 4 to 20 mA control.
600 rpm Drive, 4,056 mL/min Ceiling: Moves nearly 4.1 litres a minute at full speed for fast reactor filling and emptying.
+/-0.5% Control Accuracy: Holds a set flow steady across the run, not just at start-up.
Left and Right Rotation: Reverses on command for priming, clearing, or reversing a transfer without disconnecting tubing.
Soft Start and Electronic Brake: Gentle ramp-up and clean stop protect tubing life over repeated cycles.
Continuous 24/7 Operation: Rated for uninterrupted running, the baseline for reactor feed and chemostat applications.
Optional Foot Switch: Connects for hands-free dosing operation.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 Single Channel Peristaltic Pump used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 handles both precise reagent dosing and fast bulk fluid transfer, making it suited to reactor feed-batch dosing, chemostat operation, and rapid tank filling and emptying.

faqs.question: What flow rate does the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 deliver?
faqs.answer: In single-channel operation the pump delivers 2.0 to 4,056 mL/min, with the exact figure depending on the tubing bore fitted and the speed setting used.

faqs.question: How accurate is the dosing on the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600?
faqs.answer: Control accuracy is +/-0.5% with a precision of +/-2%, and the retraction function further protects accuracy at small dosed volumes by preventing a drop from forming at the tube tip.

faqs.question: What is the retraction function?
faqs.answer: After each pumping run, the drive briefly reverses to pull the tube back and clear the last drop at the tip, which keeps microlitre-scale dosing accurate rather than letting a hanging drop register as an error.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 be automated?
faqs.answer: Yes. RS232 and analogue interfaces, 0 to 10 V or 4 to 20 mA, put speed, direction, and start and stop under external control from a PLC or process system.

faqs.question: Does the pump include the pump head and tubing?
faqs.answer: No. The pump drive is supplied on its own; the pump head and tubing are selected separately to match your flow rate and fluid chemistry, and Inkarp confirms this configuration before quotation.

faqs.question: What is interval dosing?
faqs.answer: Interval dosing lets you set a dosing volume together with a pause time, from 0.1 seconds to 750 hours, so a multi-step dosing sequence runs unattended exactly as programmed.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 and Ultimate 120?
faqs.answer: Both carry the same dosing accuracy, interval dosing, retraction function, and interfaces. The difference is the top-end speed: 600 rpm against a 120 rpm ceiling, which sets the maximum flow rate each variant reaches.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 run continuously?
faqs.answer: Yes. The pump is rated for continuous 24/7 operation, suited to chemostat feed and other processes that cannot pause.

faqs.question: What is the part number of the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600?
faqs.answer: The part number is 523-52060-00. Inkarp is the authorized distributor for this configuration in India.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on the pump head, tubing, and accessories your application needs. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your flow rate and fluid are confirmed.

longForm.heroLead: Not every pumping application demands high flow. Some require precise, repeatable dosing, while others need rapid liquid transfer without changing equipment. The Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 is designed to handle both, delivering 2.0 to 4,056 mL/min with +/-0.5% control accuracy across a 24 to 600 rpm speed range.

sections.title: Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 at a glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate the Ultimate 600: dosing and fast conveying, automated interfaces, pump head and tubing fit, full technical data, and Inkarp installation and service support.
sections.subheading: One pump for accurate dosing and fast conveying
body: The Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600 is built around one problem: a reactor needs precise dosing while it runs, and fast bulk transfer when it does not.
One pump, two speeds of work. It delivers 2.0 to 4,056 mL/min in single-channel operation, covering microlitre dosing and rapid fill or empty work in the same drive.
Speed, tubing diameter, flow display, dosing volume, and interval pause times are stored as a profile you select instead of re-entering every parameter.
RS232 and analogue control let speed, direction, and start/stop run under a PLC or process controller through digital RS232 or analogue 0 to 10 V / 4 to 20 mA signals.
The retraction function briefly reverses after each run to pull the tube clear before a drop forms at the tip, keeping small-volume dosing cleaner and more repeatable.
Confirmed model: Hei-FLOW Ultimate 600, P/N 523-52060-00. Pump head and tubing are selected separately to match your flow rate and fluid.

sections.title: Flow rate and dosing accuracy
body: The number on the datasheet is a range; the number that matters is what your specific tubing bore delivers at your specific speed setting. Flow rate on a peristaltic pump is a function of speed and tubing internal diameter together, not speed alone.

At the low end of the 24 to 600 rpm range, a fine-bore tube delivers microlitre-scale dosing with room to spare. At 600 rpm with a wide-bore tube, the same drive moves toward its 4,056 mL/min ceiling for fast fill and empty work.

The +/-0.5% control accuracy holds the drive steady at whichever point on that curve the application sits, and the +/-2% precision figure describes how tightly repeat doses land relative to each other.
